text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INF-2026-03-15-0472 created by monitoring — EU-dedicated-cluster: elevated error rate for SolaraBank dedicated pool. Auto-paged #incidents and @marta (oncall).

marta (oncall): got it, I'm on. seeing 502 spikes on the EU-dedicated LB, roughly 10% of requests failing with upstream timeouts.

samir (sre): joining. attaching recent tail of lb logs and a quick curl test.
```
[2026-03-15T09:07:11Z] lb-eu-3 - 502 upstream timeout - route: solara-prod-tokenize
curl https://eu-dedicated.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -i
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

jon (ops): alert from infra: memory pressure on node gpud-12, OOM kills for worker pid 2211 over last 5 min. I suspect a recent quantized model build triggered higher memory usage.

engineer_lee: I pushed the last model build to gpud-12 yesterday at 02:00 UTC for the solara-prod model variant. Reverting should be quick if we confirm it's the cause.

marta (oncall): quick triage plan: 1) verify if failures tied to gpud-12 only; 2) scale down gpud-12, drain traffic; 3) prepare customer-facing impact statement for SolaraBank and status page blurb. Samir, can you confirm which customers are routed to that pool?

samir (sre): confirmed: SolaraBank (enterprise account id: SB-9881) pinned to eu-dedicated pool with weights 0.7 on gpud-12 and 0.3 on gpud-09 due to affinity. No other enterprise tenants on gpud-12 currently.

ellie (cs): copying customer success. I'm drafting an outage notification for SolaraBank contacts; want to minimize technical jargon and clearly state mitigation steps + ETA. Can we get an ETA for failover?

jon (ops): If we drain gpud-12 and scale up gpud-09, rollback of the model build should take ~12-15 min including health checks. Planning a controlled drain now.

marta (oncall): doing the drain in 2 min. I'll also add a temporary routing rule to send new requests to gpud-09 and fall back to hosted fallback if gpud-09 is saturated.

incident-bot: Action logged: gpud-12 set to DRAINING by marta at 1792345769. Notifying autoscaler.

engineer_lee: rolling back model build to previous artifact on gpud-12 now. Command:
```bash
redwood-deploy rollback --cluster eu-dedicated --node gpud-12 --artifact solara-prod:v1.4.2
```

samir (sre): monitoring request success rate. pre-change 88% p99 latency 1.8s; after routing change to gpud-09 success rate jumping to 98% within 45s.

marta (oncall): update for comms: We need two tailored messages: 1) short customer-facing email targeted to SolaraBank operations + engineering points of contact; 2) statuspage public incident with neutral wording and no customer-identifying specifics. Ellie can you push the email once I approve the content?

ellie (cs): draft below for SolaraBank ops/eng. please edit for tone.

```
Subject: Incident affecting SolaraBank on EU dedicated cluster — temporary degraded responses (Mar 15)
Hi <SolaraBank Ops>,

We’re reaching out to let you know we’re actively mitigating an issue that caused intermittent failed requests for your EU dedicated deployment starting at 09:07 UTC. Our engineers identified increased memory usage on one of the dedicated nodes serving your account which caused timeouts.

What we did: drained the affected node, shifted incoming traffic to alternate capacity, and rolled back a recent model build.

Impact: Some requests to text-generation endpoints returned errors (~10% of requests) and a small increase in latency for a brief window. We do not believe any customer data was exposed or lost.

ETA: We expect normal service to be restored and validated within 15 minutes. We will follow up when remediation completes.

If you have active requests in flight or rely on low-latency SLAs, please reply here or call our 24/7 support line at +1-800-555-0123.

Apologies for the disruption — Ellie, Customer Success (on behalf of Redwood Inference)
```

marta (oncall): tidy edits: remove phone if we want to route to the named SolaraBank on-call — replace with direct POC: +44 20 7... (ellie will fill). Add a line: "We will credit affected request units if the incident meets SLA credit threshold."

ellie (cs): updated and queued. I will send at 09:23 UTC once we confirm stabilization.

statusbot: Status page draft (public):
```
Title: Degraded responses for EU dedicated cluster (Mar 15)
Status: Investigating -> Identified -> Mitigating
Impact: Some customers on the EU dedicated cluster may see intermittent errors or elevated latency.
Update: Traffic was shifted away from an impacted node and a rollback was performed. Validation in progress.
```

samir (sre): ops note for internal handoff: reason likely memory regression triggered by quantized model variant v1.4.3. Action items for next shift: 1) add memory guardrail to deploy pipeline; 2) add canary to dedicated clusters flagged for enterprise accounts; 3) postmortem owner: samir.

marta (oncall): handing off on-call to jon ops at 09:28 UTC. Jon, please continue validation and customer comms after 09:28. I will file the incident ticket and include all logs.

jon (ops): taking over. current observed success rate 99.6%, p95 latency back to baseline. I'll run a 30-min validation window and then close incident if stable. Ellie, go ahead and send the SolaraBank email now.

ellie (cs): sent to SolaraBank ops/eng POC at 09:23 UTC, copied legal and account team. included incident id INF-2026-03-15-0472 and the mitigation summary.

incident-bot: Incident INF-2026-03-15-0472 status changed to MITIGATING at 1792345930.

jon (ops): validation window started. Logging handoff note: no customer data compromised; single node regression; rollback complete; follow-up items assigned to samir for postmortem.

engineer_lee: opening PR to add canary+memory limits: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-2891 — testing pipeline updates next.

marta (oncall): thanks everyone. if we see a regression, page @marta again. Closing slack incident thread once postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:

statusbot: Public status update posted at 09:30 UTC: "Mitigation in progress — traffic shifted and rollback applied; validation underway."

jon (ops): incident closed for customer communications after successful validation at 09:38 UTC. I will file final timeline and provide customer impact metrics (requests failed, duration, estimated credits) in the follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INF-2026-03-15-0472 marked RESOLVED at 1792346123 by jon (ops).
